title: ArtCrafter: Feed-Forward Generation of Articulated 3D Object with Analytic Joint Derivation
claim: A feed-forward model generates paired multi-state parts in one pass, then derives kinematic parameters analytically from their rigid transformation, with a geometric regularizer.
layout: 3 regions: left-to-right pipeline, analytic panel top-right, training panel bottom
description: A dense, color-coded system diagram. At left, a dashed stack of noise-latent tokens (B, R, O, R, O) and two input images (Rest in red box, Open in green box) feed an Encoder. A large 3D DiT box in the center stacks four attention blocks: Local, Triplet (a yellow fan from the base token to R/O pairs), Cross (arrows from f_rest and f_open), and Global. Denoised tokens go to a 3D VAE Decoder, which outputs a colored refrigerator mesh. The mesh goes to an Analytic URDF block and then to an XML URDF snippet. A light-blue panel (a) above shows rigid transform estimation, T in SE(3), an R/t matrix, a revolute vs. prismatic branch, and axis/origin/range rules. Panel (b) at the bottom shows training regularization: point decoder, repulsion loss, before/after point clouds. A legend sits at the bottom right. The eye goes first to the colored token stacks and the fridge mesh.
caption: ArtCrafter pipeline. Two input images ($I_{\mathrm{rest}}$, $I_{\mathrm{open}}$) are encoded into state features conditioning $2N+1$ noisy latent slots — base $B$, rest slots $R^1\!\ldots\!R^N$, open slots $O^1\!\ldots\!O^N$ — each augmented with learnable part and state embeddings. Each 3D DiT block refines slots through: Local Attn (intra-slot), Triplet Attn ($R^i \leftrightarrow O^i$ anchored through $B$), State Cross Attn (rest$\tof_{\mathrm{rest}}$, open$\tof_{\mathrm{open}}$, base$\to$both), and Global Attn (all $2N+1$ slots). The frozen VAE decoder produces part meshes from denoised slots. (a) Analytic joint derivation: joint parameters are derived deterministically from $T_i = T_{\mathrm{open},i} \cdot T_{\mathrm{rest},i}^{-1}$ with no learned head. (b) Geometric regularization: the frozen point decoder decodes $\hat{z}_{0|t}$ to per-slot point clouds; $\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{rep}}$ penalizes inter-part overlap.
abstract: Articulated 3D assets are essential for robotic simulation and training, yet their generation from casual images poses a key challenge: recovering part geometry and kinematics that remain mutually consistent. We present ArtCrafter, a novel feed-forward generative model for controllable generation of articulated 3D objects from a pair of images, one depicting the object in the rest state and the other in the open state. At the core of ArtCrafter is a DiT-based generative model that jointly produces part-level meshes for both articulation states in a single forward pass. Inspired by Slot Attention, its denoising process operates on a $1+2N$ slot layout comprising one shared base slot and $N$ paired rest/open slots, encouraging each pair to bind to the same kinematic part. To ensure geometrically consistent and disjoint part generation, we introduce Triplet Attention to enforce cross-state geometric consistency between paired rest/open slots anchored through the shared base slot, and a repulsion loss $\mathcal{L}_{\mathrm{rep}}$ on decoded part point clouds to prevent inter-part penetration throughout denoising. Given the resulting paired meshes, URDF joint parameters---type, axis, origin, and range---are derived analytically from the rigid transformation between each rest/open pair, providing an interpretable alternative to learned joint-parameter regression. Extensive experiments on both in-distribution and out-of-distribution datasets demonstrate that ArtCrafter outperforms existing method under the same dual-state setting in geometry quality and articulation precision, while remaining competitive with methods operating under different input settings and paradigms.
